DIAGNOSIS READY: Scaphoid Fracture (Non-union/Post-traumatic).

Although the X-rays showed early erosive changes suggestive of arthritis, the specific history of a fall on an outstretched hand six months ago, combined with isolated pain at the base of the thumb and negative inflammatory markers for systemic disease, strongly points to a missed or non-united scaphoid fracture that has led to secondary trauma. The "erosions" seen on the initial scan are likely secondary degenerative changes at the fracture site rather than inflammatory arthritis. I am confident in this diagnosis based on the trauma history and localized findings.
